description_en: Enables fine-grained monitoring for the current region
description_zh: 启用当前地域的秒级监控功能
kebab_example: aliyun slb enable-high-defination-monitor --tags tagKey_:_Key1_,_tagValue_:_Value1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --log-project my-project --log-store my-log-store --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: EnableHighDefinationMonitor

parameters.help_en: The tags of the logs. The tags must be key-value pairs that are contained in a JSON dictionary
parameters.help_zh: 日志标签。其结构是一个JSON dictionary，包含标签键和标签值
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region where the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance is deployed.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the project of Log Service. The name must be 4 to 63 characters in length, and can contain digits and lowercase letters. It must start and end with a digit or a letter
parameters.help_zh: 日志服务LogProject的名称。长度为4~63个字符，支持数字、小写字母，可包含短划线（-），开头和结尾必须为数字或字母
parameters.name: log_project

parameters.help_en: The name of the Logstore of Log Service. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length and can contain digits, lowercase letters, hyphens (-) and underscores (\_). It must start and end with a digit or a letter
parameters.help_zh: 日志服务LogStore的名称。长度为2~64个字符，支持数字、小写字母，可包含短划线（-）和下划线（_），开头和结尾必须为数字或字母
parameters.name: log_store
